proposals.before: for an offense he was demoted to Prefect of Chaozhou.
proposals.after: In the fourth year of Xianqing, for an offense he was demoted to Prefect of Chaozhou.
proposals.reason: Chinese opens with 顯慶四年, which the idiomatic rendering keeps but the literal omits.

proposals.before: Previously, selection assemblies had no limit and appointees were filled as they arrived; as the times gradually became peaceful the candidates grew somewhat numerous, and Jiao first requested that a great assembly be held at the winter solstice and concluded by the end of spring—this is practiced to the present.
proposals.after: Previously, selection assemblies had no limit and appointees were filled as they arrived; as the times gradually became peaceful the candidates grew somewhat numerous, and Jiao first requested that a great assembly be held in early winter and concluded by the end of spring—this is practiced to the present.
proposals.reason: 冬初 means early winter, not the winter solstice; the literal mistranslates the season.

proposals.before: He later served as long-term governor of Yizhou.
proposals.after: He later served as Administrator of Yizhou.
proposals.reason: 長史 is the Administrator (chief clerk) of a prefecture, not a "long-term governor".

proposals.before: At the time the Duke of Ying Li Ji was Long Governor; he deeply honored him.
proposals.after: At the time the Duke of Ying Li Ji was Administrator; he deeply honored him.
proposals.reason: 長史 should be Administrator, not "Long Governor".

proposals.before: Li Renbao, prefect of Dao, and his brother, magistrate of Yuci, were framed by Tang Fengyi for private divination plotting to restore the Li house.
proposals.after: Li Renbao, prefect of Dao, and his younger brother Changsha, magistrate of Yuci, were framed by Tang Fengyi for private divination plotting to restore the Li house.
proposals.reason: Chinese names the brother 長沙; the idiomatic English drops the personal name.

proposals.before: Thereupon Lady Pang's death was reduced; she was banished beyond the Ling tables; Yougong was removed from name and made commoner.
proposals.after: Thereupon Lady Pang's death was reduced; she was banished beyond the Lingnan frontier; Yougong was removed from name and made commoner.
proposals.reason: 嶺表 means the Lingnan frontier region; "Ling tables" is a mistranslation.

decisions.reason: s0034 opens with 顯慶四年; the literal omits that date while the rest of the proposed sentence matches 坐事，貶為潮州刺史.
Focus unit has 冬初一時大集; 冬初 is early winter, not the winter solstice (冬至). Replacing “at the winter solstice” with “in early winter” corrects the season without other changes.
s0040 has 益州長史; 長史 is the prefectural Administrator office title, not “long-term governor” (a false temporal reading of 長). “Administrator of Yizhou” restores the office correctly.
s0076 has 英國公李勣為長史; 長史 is Administrator, and “Long Governor” invents a mistranslation of the same title. The proposed literal keeps Duke of Ying Li Ji and the honor clause intact.
s0162 names 弟榆次令長沙; 長沙 is the younger brother’s personal name and 弟 marks younger brother. The idiomatic had dropped the name; the proposal restores both without inventing content.
s0193 has 流於嶺表; 嶺表 is the Lingnan frontier region, not “Ling tables.” The replacement “beyond the Lingnan frontier” matches the Chinese place term.
